description: Queues the confirmation email and the reminder emails of a webinar again for everyone who is already registered, which is what the host wants after a date or time changed. Side effect: it sends REAL email to all of those registrants from the host's site. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and a clear yes (`confirm` true). Check with wi_get_renotification_status how many people would receive it and where the date really stands before you write, and say that number out loud.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that all registrants may be mailed again.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_resend_webinar_mails
title: Send the confirmation and reminders again
